name: La salle de gym
camera: from the ENT-room door, facing north towards the garden

setting.walls: warm-grey limewashed brick walls lined with honey-coloured wooden wall bars
setting.floor: sprung maple floor with painted court lines
setting.landmark: a giant red exercise ball and a hanging climbing rope in front of tall arched windows onto the garden
setting.light: bright daylight through the arched garden windows
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: A MAN ("MAN") in a tracksuit waves a giant yellow foam HAND above his head as he cheers on the patients.
A girl stretches one LEG along a bench; her sock is smeared with golden apricot JAM ("ZHAHNB") from the open jar, and a bee is curious.
A parrot perches on a sailor's SHOULDER ("ay-POHL") as if on A POLE, both doing shoulder rolls.
A giant apple CORE ("KOR") with arms and legs does a big stretch, its whole BODY bending like a gymnast.
The physio stands with one bare FOOT right beside an apple PIE ("PYAY") left on the gym floor, and gasps.
A strongman curls a shiny BRASS ("BRAH") kettlebell with one huge ARM, muscles bulging.
A baker in a white hat carries a giant lump of DOUGH ("DOH") on his BACK, bending under its weight on the mat.
A shaggy GNU ("zhuh-NOO") kneels on one KNEE on the mat and offers a daisy to another gnu.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: La salle de gym in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (north, garden side). Camera: from the ENT-room door, facing north towards the garden.
Setting: warm-grey limewashed brick walls lined with honey-coloured wooden wall bars; floor: sprung maple floor with painted court lines. Landmark: a giant red exercise ball and a hanging climbing rope in front of tall arched windows onto the garden. Light: bright daylight through the arched garden windows. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the glazed door behind, at the near left foreground, showing primrose-yellow walls (way to Le cabinet ORL); glazed double doors at the BACK CENTRE showing sea-green tiles and water (way to Le bassin).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, middle distance: A MAN in a tracksuit waves a giant yellow foam HAND above his head as he cheers on the patients.
- left, foreground: A girl stretches one LEG along a bench; her sock is smeared with strawberry JAM from the open jar, and a bee is curious.
- centre-left, middle distance: A parrot perches on a sailor's SHOULDER as if on A POLE, both doing shoulder rolls.
- centre, foreground: A giant apple CORE with arms and legs does a big stretch, its whole BODY bending like a gymnast.
- centre-right, middle distance: A bare FOOT steps right into a cherry PIE left on the gym floor, and the physio gasps.
- right, foreground: A strongman curls a shiny BRASS kettlebell with one huge ARM, muscles bulging.
- far right, middle distance: A baker in a white hat carries a giant lump of DOUGH on his BACK, bending under its weight on the mat.
- far right, foreground: A shaggy GNU kneels on one KNEE on the mat and offers a daisy to another gnu.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
